technical.summary: Long-term trend structure is bullish but short-term momentum is weak with oversold RSI lacking confirmation; price below key moving averages and MACD negative create conflicting signals unsuitable for high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: KMB shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 63 days.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (10/10) presents contrarian buy opportunity despite weak congressional selling by junior member; no news data to confirm setup.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (384.48) with flat yield curve and negative macro score create severely unfavourable conditions; earnings in 63 days adds moderate event risk but is not imminent.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term trend structure (EMA 50/200 bullish, Supertrend bullish, Ichimoku above cloud) combined with extreme fear sentiment (10/10) and contrarian buy signal creates asymmetric risk/reward for patient entry near support.
debate.key_bear_argument: Short-term momentum collapse (price below EMA 9/21, MACD negative, RSI oversold without confirmation, OBV false signals) combined with crisis VIX regime, zero fundamental conviction, and imminent earnings risk (63 days) make this a low-probability swing entry despite long-term bullish structure.

decision.entry_rationale: Long-term trend structure is bullish with price at support and extreme fear sentiment presents contrarian opportunity. However, short-term momentum collapse, zero fundamental conviction, crisis macro regime, and existing KMB position make this unsuitable for swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: Crisis VIX regime (384.48) combined with earnings event in 63 days and negative short-term momentum creates high probability of whipsaw before long-term structure can reassert.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical and sentiment agents see opportunity; fundamental and risk agents strongly oppose
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding KMB position with 28 existing Consumer Staples positions (16.6% of portfolio) creates excessive sector concentration; adding to existing position violates diversification discipline.
